title: The counseling role of social workers in the electronic reality of cyber security
core_idea: Examine how social workers can function as advisors within modern cybersecurity contexts by characterizing developmental, preventive, and intervention counseling roles and by identifying barriers to their integration in cybersecurity and information security domains.
tldr: A qualitative investigation into the advisory (developmental, preventive, intervention) roles social workers could play in cyber security and the challenges to enacting those roles.
